name: Will Malfeld

description: Software by Will Malfeld, engineer and math educator: mountain-bike math games for Algebra I–Calculus, HVAC Studio for residential HVAC design, and Leverage Planner.
intro: I build small tools that solve specific problems in my
own life — then ship them so other people can use them too.
about: I'm Will Malfeld, a software engineer and educator.
I build small tools that solve specific problems in my own life — then ship them so other people can use them too. A lot of them come out of teaching and tutoring math and physics.
For my full background, see willmalfeld.com.

projects.title: Mathlete learning tools
projects.blurb: Interactive math games I built for Mathlete MTB, my math and physics tutoring for young athletes. Each one puts students in a mountain-bike scenario and runs at six levels, from Algebra I through Calculus.

projects.title: Work tools
projects.blurb: Software I'm building for my own HVAC design work, to replace tools I've outgrown.

projects.title: Personal assistant tools
projects.blurb: Tools I built to plan and run my own days.

sections.projects: Mathlete learning tools — interactive math games from Algebra I through Calculus — plus HVAC design software and personal assistant tools I built and use.
sections.lab: Prototypes and experiments — ideas with a working implementation that aren't finished products yet.
sections.notes: Writing on building software, AI and teaching.
